articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally published AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub because apparently even the cybersecurity agency can't secure its own secrets. Congressional lawmakers are now demanding answers, which is adorable—like asking why the fire department's truck is on fire.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: A CISA contractor left AWS GovCloud credentials sitting on public GitHub like a digital confession booth. The agency tasked with protecting America's infrastructure just leaked its own keys to the kingdom.

articles.title: Laravel-Lang PHP Packages Compromised to Deliver Cross-Platform Credential Stealer
articles.summary: Anthropic's Project Glasswing AI found 10,000 critical vulnerabilities in one month of operation. Finally, artificial intelligence doing something useful instead of generating another listicle about productivity hacks.

articles.title: BambuStudio has been violating PrusaSlicer AGPL license since their fork
articles.summary: CVE-2026-48172 in LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin scores a perfect 10.0 CVSS and lets attackers run scripts as root. It's being actively exploited because why wouldn't someone abuse a maximum-severity privilege escalation flaw?

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates a win for end-to-end encryption, that beautiful cryptographic middle finger to surveillance states. When implemented correctly, it turns your messages into unbreakable secrets that make three-letter agencies weep.

articles.title: Cisco used AI to write security incident reports, with mixed results
articles.summary: Trump Mobile website was allegedly leaking customer data to anyone who could craft an HTTP request. The irony of a platform named after someone obsessed with loyalty being completely disloyal to user privacy is *chef's kiss*.

articles.title: Drupal Core SQL Injection Bug Actively Exploited, Added to CISA KEV
articles.summary: TeamPCP hacker group is poisoning open source code at unprecedented scale, hitting GitHub and hundreds of organizations. Supply chain attacks: because why break down the front door when you can just poison the foundation?

articles.title: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin CVE-2026-48172 Exploited to Run Scripts as Root
articles.summary: Laravel-Lang PHP packages were compromised to deliver cross-platform credential stealers. Nothing says 'modern software development' like your language localization library secretly harvesting passwords.

articles.title: AI Agents Are Shifting Identity Security Budget Dynamics
articles.summary: Google API keys remain active for up to 23 minutes after 'deletion' despite Google claiming immediate removal. Classic cloud provider move—promise instant security, deliver a 23-minute window of vulnerability.

articles.title: AIPAC, AI, Crypto and Gambling Are Hiding Their Big Election Spends
articles.summary: Judge sanctions CoreCivic for destroying video evidence in ICE detainee death case. Private prison giant gets rare legal smackdown for the oldest trick in the corporate playbook: making inconvenient evidence disappear.
